_readme: All sales copy on slabpermits.com lives here. build_site.py reads it. Change copy here (not in code), log every change in growth/changes.md with date, page, before/after and the metric that prompted it. Page overrides: pages.<file>.title / description / intro (HTML inserted right after the page header). Trade overrides: cta_by_prefix.<file prefix>.

strip.who: For pool, solar, landscaping and fence companies in Austin.
strip.what: Every Friday: the new homes permitted in your ZIP codes, with address, size, builder and estimated move-in. Reach the owner months before they move in, before your competitors know the house exists.

cta.headline: Know about every new house in your ZIP codes 7 months before the family moves in.
cta.sub: Every Friday you get the map and a spreadsheet: full street address, square footage, builder and estimated move-in month for each new home in the ZIP codes you serve. Use it for mailers, door hangers, builder pitches or route planning. $49 a month, cancel anytime.

pool-leads.headline: Reach the families building 3,500+ sq ft homes before the pool contract goes to someone else.
pool-leads.sub: Every Friday: every big new house permitted in your ZIP codes, with address, size, builder and move-in month. One signed pool pays for years of SLAB. $49 a month, cancel anytime.

solar-leads.headline: Every new roof in your ZIP codes, months before move-in.
solar-leads.sub: Every Friday: each new home permitted in the ZIP codes you serve, with address, size, builder and move-in month. Get in front of the owner while they're still making decisions about the house. $49 a month, cancel anytime.

landscaping-leads.headline: Every bare new yard in your ZIP codes, before the owner moves in.
landscaping-leads.sub: Every Friday: new homes in your ZIP codes with address, size, builder and move-in month. Plan mailers and routes around the streets filling up next. $49 a month, cancel anytime.

fence-leads.headline: Know which streets are about to need a dozen fences at once.
fence-leads.sub: Every Friday: new homes in your ZIP codes with address, builder and move-in month, so you can pitch the builder or the whole street together. $49 a month, cancel anytime.
